name: dax_prior_year_lookup_of_a_prior_year_lookup

measures.name: Sales LY of LY
measures.formula: CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[amount]), FILTER(ALL('Date'), 'Date'[calendar_date] IN VALUES('Date'[prior_year_date]))), FILTER(ALL('Date'), 'Date'[calendar_date] IN VALUES('Date'[prior_year_date])))

expect_sql:
SELECT u.k1 AS retail_year,
       (MAX(u.s1)) AS sales_ly,
       ((MAX(u.s2))) AS sales_ly_of_ly
FROM (
SELECT c.k1 AS k1,
       SUM(t.amount) AS s1,
       NULL AS s2
FROM   (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.k1, s.date_sk AS dt
  FROM   (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.retail_year AS k1, d.prior_year_date AS dt
    FROM   retail.dim_date d
  ) c
  JOIN retail.dim_date s ON s.calendar_date = c.dt
) c
JOIN retail.fct_sales t ON t.date_sk = c.dt
GROUP BY c.k1
  UNION ALL
SELECT c.k1 AS k1,
       NULL AS s1,
       SUM(t.amount) AS s2
FROM   (
    SELECT x0.k1, x0.dt
    FROM   (
        SELECT DISTINCT c.k1, s.date_sk AS dt
        FROM   (
              SELECT x0.k1, x0.dt
              FROM   (
                  SELECT DISTINCT c.k1, s.date_sk AS dt
                  FROM   (
                        SELECT d.retail_year AS k1, d.date_sk AS dt
                        FROM   retail.dim_date d
                  ) c
                  JOIN retail.dim_date v ON v.date_sk = c.dt
                  JOIN retail.dim_date s ON s.calendar_date = v.prior_year_date
              ) x0
        ) c
        JOIN retail.dim_date v ON v.date_sk = c.dt
        JOIN retail.dim_date s ON s.calendar_date = v.prior_year_date
    ) x0
) c
JOIN retail.fct_sales t ON t.date_sk = c.dt
GROUP BY c.k1
) u
GROUP BY u.k1
